rapport_notes: Danah is polite and organized but transactional; minimal warmth, no personalization, few acknowledgments of customer's concerns.
process_discipline_notes: No repeats detected; no obvious silence-holding violations, though lack of engagement is more structural than a discrete violation.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly from pull-up of profile into logistics questions without asking 'What are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No layers at all. Customer says 'I need help with a handful of big items' and 'it's really just the heavy items.' Rep acknowledges but never probes 'tell me more' or 'what else is on your list.' She pivots straight to checkbox questions (oversized? fragile? appliances?).
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Partial anchor only: 'The hourly rate for two movers is $222... two and a half hour minimum... prorated in fifteen minute increments... around $555.' No personalization to the customer's floor/no-elevator walk. No commitment framing, no 'estimate is a window' language, no self-prep tip, no 'does that feel fair + silence.' Only the 15-min increment beat-down line is present.

top_strength: Clean logistics capture and pricing delivery—Danah efficiently collected move details, explained the rate structure clearly, gave a specific estimate ($555), and locked in the Saturday 8:30 AM slot.
coaching_note: Skip the checkbox checklist and ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' before diving into item-by-item probing—this call had zero discovery depth and missed all four differentiators (damage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time, Communication).
